name: Blessing of Ceirt [Ogham]
body:
Rejuvenation and long life are associated with the apple and blessed through the ceirt ogham.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): When subjected to a magical effect that prematurely ages you, you gain a +2 bonus to any saving throws versus the effect. In addition, choose one physical attribute (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution) and you do not suffer any penalties to that particular attribute from the effects of aging.
